# 📂 .github

[![Browse folder contents](https://img.shields.io/badge/Browse-Contents-blue)](#contents)

## Overview

GitHub reads the Sponsor button configuration from `FUNDING.yml` and discovers workflow definitions under `workflows/`. Jobs call the shell and Python helpers in `scripts/`. For installation and API information, open the [project README](../README.md).

## Contents

- [FUNDING.yml](FUNDING.yml)
- [scripts](scripts/README.md)
- [workflows](workflows/README.md)
